ex.en: It's normal to experience workplace crushes, but remember to stay professional.
ex.zh: 在職場上對人產生好感很正常，但記得保持專業。

ex.en: We want to create a safe and friendly workplace.
ex.zh: 我們希望打造一個安全友善的職場。

ex.en: Workplace stress can affect your health.
ex.zh: 職場壓力會影響你的健康。

ex.en: Despite adversity, the architect achieved worldwide fame.
ex.zh: 儘管身處逆境，那位建築師仍然享譽全球。

ex.en: The song became a worldwide hit.
ex.zh: 這首歌在全球爆紅。

ex.en: Korean entertainment culture is popular worldwide.
ex.zh: 韓國的娛樂文化在全世界都很受歡迎。

ex.en: The company has over 5,000 employees worldwide.
ex.zh: 這家公司在全球有超過五千名員工。

ex.en: Women make up half of our workforce.
ex.zh: 女性占我們員工的一半。

ex.en: The company plans to reduce its workforce by 10%.
ex.zh: 公司計畫裁減一成人力。

ex.en: Training helps build a skilled workforce.
ex.zh: 訓練有助於培養技術熟練的勞動力。

ex.en: I think it is worthwhile to see this film twice.
ex.zh: 我覺得這部電影值得看兩次。

ex.en: The hard work was worthwhile because I passed the exam.
ex.zh: 努力是值得的，因為我考過了。

ex.en: Volunteering is a worthwhile experience.
ex.zh: 當志工是很值得的經驗。

ex.en: These garments are made of 100 percent wool.
ex.zh: 這些衣服是百分之百羊毛製成的。

ex.en: Her dress was made of coarse wool.
ex.zh: 她的洋裝是用粗羊毛做的。

ex.en: These fabrics are made of pure wool.
ex.zh: 這些布料是純羊毛的。

ex.en: Cats love to run after balls of wool.
ex.zh: 貓很喜歡追毛線球。

ex.en: My grandmother bought some wool to knit a scarf.
ex.zh: 我奶奶買了一些毛線要織圍巾。

wool.zh: pull the wool over someone's eyes：矇騙某人

ex.en: You cannot pull the wool over my eyes.
ex.zh: 你騙不了我的。

ex.en: He tried to pull the wool over the customers' eyes.
ex.zh: 他試圖矇騙顧客。

ex.en: Please complete page ten in your workbook.
ex.zh: 請完成練習簿的第十頁。

ex.en: The workbook comes with an answer key.
ex.zh: 這本練習簿附有解答。

ex.en: Save the workbook before closing Excel.
ex.zh: 關閉 Excel 前先儲存活頁簿。

ex.en: This workbook has five worksheets.
ex.zh: 這個活頁簿有五個工作表。

ex.en: Due to the worsening weather, the departure was delayed.
ex.zh: 由於天氣轉壞，出發時間延後了。

ex.en: The economic situation of the country worsened.
ex.zh: 這個國家的經濟狀況惡化了。

ex.en: Traffic tends to worsen during rush hour.
ex.zh: 交通在尖峰時段往往會更糟。

ex.en: The company's financial woes continue.
ex.zh: 公司的財務困境仍在持續。

ex.en: Tom told me his tale of woe.
ex.zh: 湯姆向我訴苦。

ex.en: Your proposal is worthy of being considered.
ex.zh: 你的提議值得考慮。

ex.en: His behavior is worthy of respect.
ex.zh: 他的行為值得尊重。

worthy.zh: 有價值的、可敬的、當之無愧的

ex.en: The money will go to a worthy cause.
ex.zh: 這筆錢會捐給有意義的公益。

ex.en: She was a worthy winner of the award.
ex.zh: 她得這個獎實至名歸。

ex.en: The teacher handed out a grammar worksheet.
ex.zh: 老師發了一張文法練習卷。

ex.en: Please finish the worksheet before Friday.
ex.zh: 請在星期五前完成學習單。

ex.en: Click the tab to add a new worksheet in Excel.
ex.zh: 點選分頁就能在 Excel 新增工作表。

ex.en: Copy the data into the second worksheet.
ex.zh: 把資料複製到第二張工作表。

ex.en: The difference is this: he works harder than you.
ex.zh: 差別在於：他比你更努力工作。

ex.en: I worked hard in order to support my family.
ex.zh: 我努力工作來養家。

ex.en: You have to get this work finished by noon.
ex.zh: 你必須在中午前完成這項工作。

ex.en: I have a lot of work to do today.
ex.zh: 我今天有很多工作要做。

ex.en: The printer isn't working.
ex.zh: 印表機壞了。

ex.en: Your plan worked perfectly.
ex.zh: 你的計畫完全奏效。

ex.en: This museum has many works by Picasso.
ex.zh: 這間美術館有很多畢卡索的作品。

ex.en: His latest work is a novel about Taiwan.
ex.zh: 他最新的作品是一部關於台灣的小說。

ex.en: English is spoken in many countries around the world.
ex.zh: 世界上許多國家都說英語。

ex.en: Taipei 101 was once the tallest building in the world.
ex.zh: 台北101曾是世界最高的大樓。

ex.en: He has a strong influence over the business world.
ex.zh: 他在商界很有影響力。

ex.en: She is well known in the fashion world.
ex.zh: 她在時尚界很有名。

ex.en: The woman sitting over there is his present wife.
ex.zh: 坐在那邊的女士是他現在的妻子。

ex.en: Out of the 6 members, a third are women.
ex.zh: 六名成員中有三分之一是女性。

ex.en: In that age, men and women wore similar hairstyles.
ex.zh: 在那個時代，男女的髮型很相似。

ex.en: I am not sure how to pronounce the word.
ex.zh: 我不確定這個字怎麼唸。

ex.en: 80% of all English words come from other languages.
ex.zh: 英文單字中有八成來自其他語言。

ex.en: Mike said a few words by way of suggestion.
ex.zh: 麥克說了幾句話作為建議。

ex.en: Can I have a word with you?
ex.zh: 我可以跟你談一下嗎？

ex.en: You can take her at her word on that.
ex.zh: 這件事你可以相信她說的話。

ex.en: He gave me his word that he would help.
ex.zh: 他向我保證會幫忙。

ex.en: In other words, we need more time.
ex.zh: 換句話說，我們需要更多時間。

ex.en: In other words, the project failed.
ex.zh: 換句話說，這個專案失敗了。

ex.en: You don't need to worry about such a thing.
ex.zh: 你不必擔心這種事。

ex.en: She was worried that she might miss the train.
ex.zh: 她擔心會趕不上火車。

ex.en: Don't worry. I told you everything would be OK.
ex.zh: 別擔心，我跟你說過一切都會沒事的。

ex.en: No worries, I will send you to the elevator.
ex.zh: 沒關係，我送你到電梯口。

ex.en: Money is my biggest worry right now.
ex.zh: 錢是我現在最大的煩惱。

ex.en: I wonder which of the runners will come first.
ex.zh: 我在想哪位跑者會跑第一。

ex.en: I cannot help wondering if he will come on time.
ex.zh: 我忍不住想他會不會準時到。

ex.en: I've always wondered what it'd be like to have siblings.
ex.zh: 我一直很好奇有兄弟姊妹會是什麼感覺。

wonder.zh: I wonder if…：（客氣請求）不知道能不能……

ex.en: I wonder if you have something to write with.
ex.zh: 不知道你有沒有可以寫字的東西？

ex.en: I wonder if you could help me with this.
ex.zh: 不知道你能不能幫我處理這件事？

ex.en: No wonder you're tired; you worked all night.
ex.zh: 難怪你這麼累，你熬了一整夜。

ex.en: No wonder the store is so crowded today.
ex.zh: 難怪今天店裡這麼擠。

ex.en: The workers complained when their working hours were extended.
ex.zh: 工時被延長時，工人們都在抱怨。

ex.en: This company allows its workers to work from home.
ex.zh: 這家公司允許員工在家工作。

ex.en: The rescue worker searched the area, looking for the child.
ex.zh: 救難人員搜索那一帶，尋找那個孩子。

ex.en: This dictionary is very expensive, but is worth buying.
ex.zh: 這本字典雖然很貴，但值得買。

ex.en: That music is worth listening to many times.
ex.zh: 那首音樂值得一聽再聽。

ex.en: If it is worth doing, do it well.
ex.zh: 值得做的事就要做好。

ex.en: The frame itself is worth more than the picture.
ex.zh: 畫框本身比畫還值錢。

ex.en: This painting is worth a great deal of money.
ex.zh: 這幅畫很值錢。

ex.en: I have self-studied half a semester's worth of German.
ex.zh: 我自學了半學期份量的德文。

ex.en: He bought 500 dollars' worth of books.
ex.zh: 他買了五百美元的書。

ex.en: The show was wonderful, but the tickets were too expensive.
ex.zh: 這場表演很精彩，但門票太貴了。

ex.en: This is the most wonderful present I have ever received.
ex.zh: 這是我收過最棒的禮物。

ex.en: Thank you very much for the wonderful dinner last night.
ex.zh: 非常感謝您昨晚美好的晚餐。

ex.en: The statue was carved from a block of cherry wood.
ex.zh: 這座雕像是用一塊櫻桃木雕成的。

ex.en: In the village we still heat our homes with wood.
ex.zh: 在村子裡，我們還是燒木頭讓家裡保暖。

ex.en: This table is made of solid wood.
ex.zh: 這張桌子是實木做的。

ex.en: One day she met a wolf in the woods.
ex.zh: 有一天，她在樹林裡遇到一匹狼。

ex.en: He lives in the woods all by himself.
ex.zh: 他獨自住在樹林裡。

ex.en: He cleansed the wound before putting on a bandage.
ex.zh: 他先清洗傷口，再包上繃帶。

ex.en: "I need to inspect the wound," said the doctor.
ex.zh: 「我需要檢查一下傷口。」醫生說。

ex.en: A wounded whale washed up on the beach.
ex.zh: 一頭受傷的鯨魚被沖上海灘。

ex.en: Many thousands on both sides had been wounded.
ex.zh: 雙方都有好幾千人受傷。

ex.en: The garden was surrounded by a wooden fence.
ex.zh: 花園被木頭圍籬圍了起來。

ex.en: How much does the wooden chair cost?
ex.zh: 那張木椅要多少錢？

ex.en: My wooden bed is actually quite heavy.
ex.zh: 我的木床其實很重。

ex.en: I attended a writing workshop last weekend.
ex.zh: 我上週末參加了一個寫作工作坊。

ex.en: The workshop will teach you basic coding skills.
ex.zh: 這個工作坊會教你基本的程式技能。

ex.en: I adapted the garage for use as a workshop.
ex.zh: 我把車庫改成工作室。

ex.en: An old worker was found repairing machinery in the workshop.
ex.zh: 有人看到一位老工人在車間裡修理機器。

ex.en: My workload has doubled since my colleague left.
ex.zh: 同事離職後，我的工作量多了一倍。

ex.en: We need to share the workload more fairly.
ex.zh: 我們需要更公平地分擔工作量。
